net sales.heading: Revenue recognition
net sales.text: Essentially all Aebi Schmidt’s revenue is generated through contracts with its customers. Aebi Schmidt may recognize revenue over time or at a point in time when or as obligations under the terms of a contract with its customer are satisfied, depending on the terms and features of the contract and the products supplied. Aebi Schmidt’s contracts generally do not have any significant variable consideration. The collectability of consideration on the contract is reasonably assured before revenue is recognized. On certain vehicles, payment may be received in advance of Aebi Schmidt satisfying its performance obligations. Such payments are recorded in Contract liabilities on the Consolidated Balance Sheets. The corresponding performance obligations are generally satisfied within one year of the contract inception. Aebi Schmidt has elected to utilize the practical expedient to recognize the incremental costs of obtaining a contract as an expense when incurred because the amortization period for the prepaid costs that would have otherwise been deferred and amortized is one year or less. Aebi Schmidt uses an observable price to allocate the stand-alone selling price to separate performance obligations within a contract or a cost-plus margin approach when an observable price is not available.

intro.text: Aebi Schmidt Holdings AG is a leading global manufacturer of specialty vehicles. We are headquartered in Switzerland and employ around 5,700 people. We operate in 17 countries through our own sales and service organizations, with more than 70 locations worldwide, including over a dozen production facilities and a dense network of upfitting and service centers. Through established partnerships with dealers, we are represented in more than 90 additional countries globally. Our core offerings include solutions and equipment for snow removal and de-icing, street and runway sweepers, truck and recreational vehicle (“RV”) chassis, as well as truck bodies and vehicle upfitting for a wide range of commercial fleets and vocations. Furthermore, we produce specialty vehicles and equipment for municipal and airport maintenance services as well as for the cultivation of steep and challenging terrain.

net sales.text: Essentially all Aebi Schmidt’s revenue is generated through contracts with its customers. Aebi Schmidt’s contracts generally do not have any significant variable consideration. The collectability of consideration on the contract is reasonably assured before revenue is recognized. On certain vehicles, payment may be received in advance of Aebi Schmidt satisfying its performance obligations. Such payments are recorded in Contract liabilities on the Consolidated Balance Sheets. The corresponding performance obligations are generally satisfied within one year of the contract inception. Aebi Schmidt has elected to utilize the practical expedient to recognize the incremental costs of obtaining a contract as an expense when incurred because the amortization period for the prepaid costs that would have otherwise been deferred and amortized is one year or less. lines.name: Goodwill
lines.why: Paid for acquired businesses: operating.

lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Accrued compensation

lines.name: Deferred revenue
lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.

lines.name: Current portion of long-term debt

lines.name: Long-term debt
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities
lines.why: Other long-term operating obligations: operating.

lines.name: Other current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current assets minus the current lines above: current assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current assets (total assets − current assets) minus the non-current lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current liabilities minus the current lines above: current liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current liabilities (total liabilities − current liabilities) minus the non-current lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
